_README: Competition configuration for the live scoring engine.
Rules: FAI Sporting Code Section 7F, 2026 edition V1.0.
The three values under 'S7F 5' MUST be set by the meet director before
the first task. They are not in the .xctsk file and every task-validity
number is meaningless if they are wrong. The values below are PLACEHOLDERS
-- replace them with this competition's real parameters.
name: Cto. de Espana Cat. Sport 2026
_s7f_5: Competition parameters. Delete a name from 'placeholders' below once it is real.
_launch_validity: Pilots present at take-off (S7F 10.1). null = count tracklogs.
_s7f_13_2: Time points for reaching ESS but not goal. Paragliding: 0. Hang-gliding: 0.8.
_s7f_13_4: Stopped-task score-back, minutes. Paragliding 5, hang-gliding 15. Not yet applied.
_altitude: Which altitude scores goal crossings (S7F 13.1): 'gps' or 'baro'.
_fixed: Fixed by S7F but exposed so a rule change does not need a code change.
_tasks: Per-task overrides keyed by task name. S7F 11 sets LeadingTimeRatio per
task; S7F 13.1 sets elevated_goal_m when goal is on high ground.
The 'Task' entry below is READ BACK FROM THE PUBLISHED RESULT for Bassano
T2.3, not taken from a task file, because neither value is in the .xctsk:
leading_time_ratio 0.2632 -- the official points allocation is
is 0.2632 whatever the goal ratio was. S7F 11 gives 26% for
paragliding, so CONFIRM THIS WITH THE MEET DIRECTOR.
elevated_goal_m 200 -- the official Low P column is the S7F 13.1
reduction, and inverting the published curve gives an elevation band
of 200 m, not the 300 m default. Three independent pilots agree
(heights 150 m, 18 m and 6 m all invert to 200).
